skipped.reason: Ohio State side checksums correctly (players sum to 72 = final score 72), but Illinois side does not: player PTS column sums to 94 while the sheet's own TOTALS row and final score read 95. Traced the 1-point gap to the Redmon F-C line (FGA17 FG9 FTA3 FT2 PF3 PTS19) — 2*FG+FT = 20, not the 19 printed in the PTS column. Re-read the page a second time and confirmed identical digits both times, so this is not a legibility/OCR issue but an apparent arithmetic error on the original 1965 scoresheet. Per policy, skipping rather than guessing which figure (FG, FT, or PTS) is the typo.
